DELTA_THETA_PSI.definition: relative phase applied to reduced components [1,3] of both charge species
DELTA_THETA_PSI.selection_rule: canonical phase and quarter-turn sign partners

ETA_Q.selection_rule: factor-two log-symmetric variation around the accepted canonical 0.2

F_PERP_POSITIVE_LOADING_INITIAL_v1.low_high_rule: low/high use one-half/two-times reference descendant amplitude, equivalently anchor loading odds divided/multiplied by four

MU_MASS_DOMAIN.definition: m*L_x with L_x fixed to one
MU_MASS_DOMAIN.selection_rule: accepted canonical value and one factor-two mass/domain variation

THETA_W.selection_rule: accepted nontrivial anchor, its sign partner, and the trivial holonomy

claim_ceiling: Guardrail-v1 preparation freezes a bounded 14-row design, positive-loading reconstruction, materiality rules, controls, pilot subset, classifications, and nonclaims. No pilot, calibration, robustness execution, pillar, seam, CCFT, C_k, or master-action claim is authorized before independent review.

comparator_policy.forced_comparator_use: negative control for descendant necessity only

descendant_observables.definition: registered spinor-to-phi2 exchange integral with the accepted sign convention
registered spinor-to-phi3 exchange integral with the accepted sign convention
sqrt(|Box(phi2)-J2|^2+|Box(phi3)-J3|^2) evaluated for the forced truncation

measurement_contract.C_PERP_SOURCE_NORM: max_t sqrt(||J2||_2^2+||J3||_2^2) in the forced comparator
measurement_contract.F_EXCHANGE_PERP: (|X2|+|X3|)/(|X_longitudinal|+|X2|+|X3|+epsilon_exchange_floor) using the maximum absolute cumulative exchanges
measurement_contract.R_PERP_OBSERVABLE: max_t ||O_full-O_comparator||_2/(max_t ||O_full||_2+epsilon_observable_floor), reported separately for every registered O
measurement_contract.T_DIVERGENCE: first stored time at which the corresponding pointwise-in-time R_perp,O reaches delta_O; RIGHT_CENSORED_AT_DURATION if absent
measurement_contract.full_vs_comparator_alignment: same parent row, grid, time samples, duration, and solver settings
measurement_contract.signed_total_energy_role: physical conservation and exchange diagnostic only
measurement_contract.spatial_constraint_norm: max_x absolute value, with L2 also reported
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_energy_changes: maximum absolute departure from the row's initial value
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_exchange: maximum absolute cumulative registered exchange over the common duration
measurement_contract.time_aggregation_for_residuals: maximum over every stored time sample

pilot_freeze.calibration_generation_rule: for each numerical residual/floor, take the maximum across every frozen pilot row and calibration refinement, multiply by two, and round upward to one significant digit

positive_controls.expected: Exact canonical inputs reproduce the accepted registered result within exact canonical thresholds.
Charge-conjugate transport and registered symmetry relations hold.
J2=J3=0 is analytically and numerically preserved without generalization.
Initially unexcited descendants respond when admitted transverse currents are nonzero.
The phi2 channel is resolved with its energy and exchange registered.
The phi3 channel is resolved with its energy and exchange registered.
The accepted symmetry-related phi2/phi3 interchange produces the preregistered relation.
The weaker eta_q point approaches the registered decoupled trend without changing the model definition.

descendant_profile.scaling_rule: multiply phi2, P2, phi3, and P3 by the reconstructed finite alpha

reference_initial_state_freeze.strict_positivity_witness: Every scientific row has m>=1 and the fixed total matter number is strictly positive, so B_plus>=m*N_total>0.

descendant_significance_classes.definition: The forced truncation is noninvariant, while preregistered observable differences remain small over the tested duration in a reported subdomain.
Transverse descendants carry a preregistered substantial exchange fraction or strongly alter longitudinal or matter evolution.
Descendant contributions are resolved and material but do not cross the descendant-dominated gate.

descendant_significance_decision_rules.DESCENDANTS_DYNAMICALLY_NECESSARY_QUANTI: the structural noninvariance/source residual is resolved while all registered R_PERP and F_EXCHANGE_PERP values remain below 0.1
descendant_significance_decision_rules.DESCENDANT_DOMINATED_REGIME: resolved evidence has F_EXCHANGE_PERP>=0.5 or any registered R_PERP_OBSERVABLE>=0.5
descendant_significance_decision_rules.INTERMEDIATE_DESCENDANT_CONTRIBUTION: resolved evidence crosses a 0.1 materiality gate but neither dominated gate
descendant_significance_decision_rules.NO_SIGNIFICANCE_CLASS_WHEN_BLOCKED: no descendant-significance class is assigned when required numerical evidence is blocked or outside the model domain

robustness_decision_rules.BROADLY_ROBUST: every full-model scientific row meets every frozen numerical-quality and control criterion and the conclusion is not threshold-sensitive
robustness_decision_rules.CONDITIONALLY_ROBUST: a nonempty explicitly listed preregistered subdomain meets every criterion but the full frozen matrix does not
robustness_decision_rules.MODEL_DOMAIN_LIMITED: one or more preregistered rows exit the admitted classical model domain; the row remains reported
robustness_decision_rules.NUMERICALLY_BLOCKED: one or more required rows lack controlled solver, residual, or convergence evidence
robustness_decision_rules.THRESHOLD_SENSITIVE: the robustness or descendant-significance conclusion changes across the frozen 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 sensitivity values

robustness_status_classes.definition: The complete model meets every frozen criterion across the full preregistered domain.
The complete model meets the frozen criteria only on an explicitly reported preregistered subdomain.
A conclusion changes materially under the preregistered admissible threshold-sensitivity analysis.
No controlled numerical conclusion is available for part or all of the domain.
The classical PDE surrogate ceases to provide a controlled result in an explicitly identified region.

threshold_freeze.reason_numerical_values_pending: Only a reviewed non-authoritative pilot may calibrate numerical floors and solver thresholds under the frozen rules.
